title: Routes load directly and through links, history walks back and forward, and the color mode persists
intent: Each route loads on its own; real links and the browser's back and forward buttons move between routes with the right heading and current-page state; the narrow site menu opens and closes from the keyboard; and a color mode picked with the visible control survives a reload.

storage.reason: The site writes the color-mode preference itself when the visible control is pressed, and the reload reads it back; the context starts with empty storage and is closed afterwards.

preconditions: Storage is empty, so the color mode follows the system preference and System is pressed.
At 48rem and wider the header carries the Site links and the Color mode control; below it the header has the Toggle navigation button and the footer carries Color mode.

steps.expect: Each shows its own level-one heading and fits the window width within one pixel.

steps.action: On /, follow the Installation guide link.
steps.expect: The URL is /install, the heading is Install, and the Install link is the current page.

steps.action: Narrow only: focus Toggle navigation, press Enter, then press Escape.
steps.expect: The Ultima menu opens with focus inside it, and Escape closes it with focus back on Toggle navigation.

steps.action: Follow the Tokens link: the header's at desktop width, the reopened menu's at narrow width.
steps.expect: The URL is /tokens, the heading is Tokens, and the narrow menu has closed.

steps.action: Press the browser's Back twice, then Forward twice.
steps.expect: The URL and heading walk /install, /, /install, /tokens, and Tokens is the current page again.

steps.action: In the visible Color mode group, press the mode the system is not using, then reload.
steps.expect: The page repaints in that mode; after the reload the same mode is pressed and painted.
